# Copilot instructions entrypoint

This repository uses task-scoped documentation. Read only what the current task needs.

- Always: `docs/rules/general-rules.md`
- Coding tasks: `docs/rules/implementation-rules.md`
- Architecture decisions: `docs/rules/adr-rules.md`, `docs/adr/README.md`, `docs/adr/process.md`
- Architecture ideas not yet decided: `docs/architecture/notes/README.md`
- Documentation changes: `docs/rules/documentation-rules.md`
- Branches and merges: `docs/processes/git-workflow.md`
- Current architecture: `docs/architecture/overview.md`
- Session notes: `docs/sessions/README.md`
  - For every new session, follow the lifecycle protocol in this document from start to closure/interruption.

This file routes only. It carries no rules of its own.
